fields.Name: T193 - Admin GraphQL Console
fields.Description: Opens the Admin app's Developer Tools section and navigates to the GraphQL Console sub-section. Verifies the GraphQL console/editor renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) - the pinned app list is short and Admin is visible without scrolling. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'GraphQL Console' sub-section. The success state is the GraphQL console/editor rendered, showing a query editor pane (and typically a run button or results/schema panel) OR a valid empty editor. This is a developer tool view, so accept an empty editor as long as the console chrome renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for the console to render rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin application is active and the Developer Tools section is open
The GraphQL Console sub-section is selected and a query editor/console pane renders
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
